verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the REST API reference listing a 'Batch' resource (trello-docs-21). That suggests a first-party way to group multiple API operations into one call, but the pack gives no detail on what Batch supports, whether it covers writes, or its item limits. The generic automation claim and the MCP server mention are adjacent features and do not show bulk operations themselves. missing for 10: documentation of what the Batch endpoint can do (read vs. write, item limits), in-app bulk select/edit of many cards, bulk operations exposed through automation or the MCP server, hands-on corroboration.
